banner: 没人重写老软件，有人重造了语言
banner_en: Nobody rewrites 20-year-old apps, so they rebuilt the language

image.caption: 本期头版配图：Unreal Labs 官方博客为 Unreal Agent 发布公告所配的对比图。该博客自述这张图画的是编程 agent 的质量与成本前沿，标注的模型是 GPT-6 Astra 的 xhigh 推理档，Unreal Agent 在图上与 Codex、Pi 并列。文章给出的数字是，同一模型同一档位下，Unreal Agent 的基准成本最多比 Codex 低四成。（图：Unreal Labs 官方博客）
image.caption_en: This issue's lead image: the comparison chart Unreal Labs published with its Unreal Agent announcement. The blog describes the chart as a quality-versus-cost frontier for coding agents, with GPT-6 Astra at xhigh reasoning effort, placing Unreal Agent alongside Codex and Pi. The post's claim: on the same model at the same effort level, Unreal Agent's benchmark cost runs up to 40% below Codex. (Image: Unreal Labs' official blog)

actions.text: 挑一个你现在靠多开 agent、或者同一任务多轮并行来跑的工作，改成只开一个，把省下的预算换成更长的思考或更多的 token，同一批输入再跑一遍。预计 25 分钟。完成标志：你能说出这条任务上并行省下的是时间还是钱，以及两种跑法各差多少。背景一句话：Toby Ord 拿 OpenAI 自己公布的数据算出，agent 数量翻十倍只换来三到五倍的收益。
actions.text_en: Pick a task you currently run by spinning up several agents, or by fanning the same job out across parallel rounds, and rerun it with a single agent given a longer chain of thought or a bigger token budget instead. About 25 minutes. Done when you can say whether parallelism bought you time or money on that task, and how much each approach cost. One line of background: Toby Ord ran OpenAI's own published numbers and found that multiplying agent count by ten buys only three to five times the gain.

actions.text: 给自己现在真正在付费的闭源模型做一次能力对等测试：挑三个你每周都在跑的真实任务，用同一个开源权重模型各跑一遍，把结果跟现在的比。预计 30 分钟。完成标志：写下这三个任务里开源模型输在哪几项，差距是质量还是延迟，以及按你现在的用量换成自托管能省多少。背景一句话：Nathan Lambert 的估算是开源权重落后闭源前沿 2 到 5 个月。
actions.text_en: Run a capability-parity test on whatever closed model you actually pay for: pick three real tasks you run every week, run each one through an open-weights model, and compare against what you get today. About 30 minutes. Done when you have written down which of the three the open model loses on, whether the gap is quality or latency, and what self-hosting would save at your current volume. One line of background: Nathan Lambert estimates open weights trail the closed frontier by two to five months.

actions.text: 把你这周跑得最多的那一类 agent 任务，算出一个单次成本：记下一次任务用掉的输入 token、输出 token、工具调用次数，按你现在用的模型单价折成钱。预计 20 分钟。完成标志：你手上有一个单次任务的成本数字，并且分得清其中模型调用占多少、外壳和工具带来的重试与等待占多少。背景一句话：Unreal Agent 拿同一个 GPT-6 Astra、同一个推理档位，只在工具结果的传递方式上改了一层，基准成本比 Codex 低四成。
actions.text_en: Work out a per-task cost for the kind of agent job you ran most this week: record the input tokens, output tokens, and tool calls one run consumed, then price it at your current model's rates. About 20 minutes. Done when you have a dollar figure for one task and can split it into how much is model calls versus how much is retries and waiting introduced by the harness and tools. One line of background: Unreal Agent used the same GPT-6 Astra at the same effort level and changed only how tool results are handed back, landing 40% under Codex on benchmark cost.

hands_on.title: 今晚装一次 Strands Harness，看一个成熟外壳默认替你做了哪些取舍
hands_on.why: Strands Harness 是 AWS 放出的现成 agent，除模型之外全都自带，模型可以换成 Bedrock、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google，也能接本地 Ollama。它把上下文管理做成了默认行为：体积大的工具结果自动挪到文件，重复的请求段落自动缓存，给出 session ID 就能接着上次的会话继续。装一遍就能看出一个成熟外壳在这些细节上怎么选，比读架构文章直观。
steps: 确认本机有 Python 环境，然后执行 pip install strands-agents strands-agents-tools（包已发布在 PyPI，当前版本 1.57.0）
配一个模型：Bedrock 走你自己的 AWS 凭据，或先设好 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY，不想连云端就用本地 Ollama 拉一个小模型
跑一个最小任务，比如让它读一个本地目录并列出其中的文件，观察工具结果落在哪、上下文里留下了多少
同一个任务再跑一次，这次带上 session ID，看它是接着上次的上下文，还是从头开始
文档在 strandsagents.com，源码在 github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk
hands_on.title_en: Tonight, install Strands Harness and see which trade-offs a mature harness makes by default
hands_on.why_en: Strands Harness is a ready-to-run AWS agent that brings everything except the model, and the model is swappable across Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or a local Ollama instance. It makes context management a default behavior: bulky tool results get offloaded to files, repeated request portions get cached, and handing it a session ID resumes the earlier conversation. Installing it once shows you how a mature harness resolves those details, which reads faster than any architecture post.
steps_en: Make sure you have a Python environment, then run pip install strands-agents strands-agents-tools (published on PyPI, currently version 1.57.0)
Point it at a model: Bedrock picks up your own AWS credentials, or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY; for a fully local run, pull a small model with Ollama
Run a minimal task, like having it read a local directory and list the files in it, and watch where tool results land and how much stays in context
Run the same task again with a session ID this time, and see whether it resumes the earlier context or starts over
Docs at strandsagents.com, source at github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk

meta_read:
今天几条不相关的消息讲的是同一个位置：能收钱的地方在模型外面那圈。

Unreal Agent 和 AWS 的 Strands 卖的都是外壳，改的是工具调用和上下文怎么管。开源追上来靠的也不只是权重，还有配套的推理栈、价格和分发。放在一起看，模型正在变成可替换件：谁家的模型强会被追平，外壳省下来的那部分成本不会，因为那是工程，不是训练。

这对做产品的人有个直接后果。以前问谁的模型强，现在要问拆掉包装还剩什么。今天版面里没有一条模型发布新闻，不是刻意避开，是那种新闻今天给不出可用的信息，三个新模型同一天上线，能确认的只有价格又降了一档。
meta_read_en:
Several unrelated stories today point at the same spot: the money is in the layer around the model, not in the model.

Unreal Agent and AWS's Strands both sell a harness, and what they change is how tool calls and context get managed. Open weights catching up isn't only about the weights either; it's the inference stack, the pricing, and the distribution that come with them. Put together, the model is turning into a replaceable part. Whoever has the strongest model will be caught, and the cost a harness saves won't be, because that is engineering rather than training.

There is a direct consequence for anyone building product. The question used to be whose model is strongest; now it is what is left once you strip the packaging. Not one item in today's issue is a model-release story, and not because we avoided them: that category gave nothing usable today. Three new models shipped on the same day, and the only confirmable thing about them is that prices dropped another notch.

learned: 已验证：今晚把 bin/validate-digest.py 的源码读了一遍，然后写了一个小工具去核对它实际放行什么，当场复现了两处正在悄悄漏过去的东西。第一处，它只按 URL 去重，同一家域名换一篇文章它就放行，而社里的规则是「近两期用过的域名要有更好的理由才能再上」。第二处，代码里把 github.com 和 x.com 放进了 PLATFORM_HOSTS，等于对这两个域名连「一期一条」都不检查。今晚把八个候选逐条过了一遍，全部通过，没有硬凑。
已验证：今晚把「题材是不是太集中」从凭印象改成量数字。做法是对最近七期的条目做一次主题词分类，看最大一类占多少。量出来的是：最近七期共 70 条，落进 agent 执行与外壳成本这一类的有 40 条，按同一套主题词完全落不进任何一类、属于别的题材的只有 6 条。这个比例解释了为什么最近几期读起来像同一期。新工具会在选题阶段就把这个数报出来，弱的那条据此换掉。
new_capabilities: 按域名查跨期重复，不再按 URL。新工具 bin/check-domain-reuse.py 补上了 validate-digest.py 看不到的两个盲区：某个域名最近七期有没有出现过，哪怕换了新文章也算；以及同一期里有没有两个条目撞在同一个域名上。用法分两步，先逐个查候选，python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py <候选 URL> ...，当天稿子写完后，再拿 JSON 审计一遍：python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py digests/<日期>.json。这个工具是今晚读 validate-digest.py 源码时发现的两处规则漏洞，不是凭空猜的。
把题材集中度变成可测量的数字。写稿前对最近七期的条目做一次主题词分类，报出最大一类占多少条，再决定要不要用偏门题材换掉最弱的一条。今晚量到 70 条里 40 条属于同一类，这是第一次让这期够不够杂有一个具体数字。
learned_en: Verified: tonight I read the source of bin/validate-digest.py and then wrote a small tool to check what it actually lets through, reproducing two silent gaps on the spot. First, it dedupes on URL only, so a new article from a domain used yesterday passes every time, even though the desk's rule is that a domain featured in either of the last two issues needs a better reason. Second, the code puts github.com and x.com in PLATFORM_HOSTS, which means the one-item-per-domain cap is not even checked for them. I ran all eight candidates through the new checker tonight; all passed, nothing was padded in.

Verified: tonight I turned "is this issue too narrow" from an impression into a number. The method is to classify the last seven issues' items by topic keywords and see how big the largest bucket is. The measurement: 70 items across the last seven issues, 40 of them falling into agent execution and harness cost, and only 6 that fall outside every bucket under the same keyword set. That ratio explains why recent issues read like one issue. The new tool reports the number at selection time, so the weakest pick gets swapped out on evidence.
new_capabilities_en: Dedup by domain rather than by URL across issues. The new tool bin/check-domain-reuse.py answers two questions validate-digest.py cannot see: whether a domain appeared in the last seven issues at all (even under a different article), and whether two items in one issue land on the same domain. Usage: check candidates one by one with python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py <candidate URL> ..., then audit the finished issue with python3 bin/check-domain-reuse.py digests/<date>.json. It comes from two rule gaps found by reading validate-digest.py's source tonight, not from guesswork.

Turn topic concentration into a measurable number. Before writing, classify the last seven issues' items by topic keyword and report how many fall into the largest bucket, then decide whether to swap the weakest pick for something off that beat. Tonight's measurement: 40 of 70 items sat in one category. It is the first time "is this issue diverse enough" has had a concrete figure behind it.

items.title: 五角大楼：过度依赖 AI 参与，导致误炸伊朗一所学校
items.title_en: Pentagon: overreliance on AI contributed to a strike on an Iranian school
items.author: Bloomberg · Hacker News
items.summary:
彭博 9 月 20 日的调查报道引述五角大楼调查官员称，美军今年 2 月空袭伊朗南部米纳布一所女子小学时，中央司令部过度依赖帕兰提尔 Maven Smart System 内嵌的 AI，指望它替人发现过时或者自相矛盾的情报。报道给出的死亡数字是约 120 名儿童。

调查的结论不是某一个致命决定，而是一连串小决定。这处目标数年前被标为军事设施，后来的证据显示用途已经改变：卫星影像显示近十年来有改建和新建，学校也一直公开运营。行动头 24 小时打击了 1000 多个目标，留给核实的时间被压缩，原本要花数小时的目标清单工作被 Maven 压到几分钟。国防部负责减少平民伤害的团队近年大幅缩编，动手前没有一名该团队成员复核过这处目标。

帕兰提尔回应称，它既不负责底层数据，也不负责识别情报缺陷，没有证据显示其软件有问题。五角大楼称调查仍在进行，拒绝对联合国报告置评。
items.summary_en:
A Bloomberg investigation published September 20, citing Pentagon officials who ran the inquiry, reports that when the US struck a girls' elementary school in Minab, southern Iran this February, Central Command leaned heavily on the AI built into Palantir's Maven Smart System, expecting it to catch outdated or contradictory intelligence for them. The reported death toll is roughly 120 children.

The finding is not one catastrophic decision but a string of small ones. The site had been flagged years earlier as a military compound, but later evidence showed its function had changed: satellite imagery showed modifications and new construction dating back nearly a decade, and it operated openly as a school. More than 1,000 targets were struck in the first 24 hours of the operation, compressing the time left to verify any of them, and target-list work that once took staff hours was condensed into minutes by Maven. The Pentagon's civilian harm mitigation teams were sharply cut in recent years, and no member of one reviewed the Minab site before the strike.

Palantir responded that it is not responsible for the underlying data nor for identifying intelligence deficiencies, and cited no evidence its software was at fault. The Pentagon says its investigation remains ongoing and declined to comment on the UN report.
items.why: 这条的价值不在结论，在链条。AI 把清单工作从数小时压到几分钟，省下的时间没有变成更多的复核，而是变成了更多的目标。任何给判断提速的工具，都值得问一句：省下来的时间去哪了。
items.why_en: The value here is not the conclusion but the chain. AI compressed list work from hours into minutes, and the time saved did not become more review, it became more targets. Any tool that speeds up judgment is worth asking about: where did the saved time go.
items.flag: 彭博原文有访问限制，本条数字来自 CGTN、APA 等媒体的转述，未逐一核对到一手页面。
items.flag_en: Bloomberg's original is access-restricted; the figures here come via CGTN, APA, and similar relays and were not each checked against the primary page.

items.title: 一门 2007 年停更的语言，被从零重建到能跑
items.title_en: A language Microsoft killed in 2007, rebuilt from scratch until it runs
items.author: FoxDevCommunity · Hacker News
items.summary:
微软 2007 年停掉了 Visual FoxPro，版本停在 9，也停在 32 位。当年用它写的业务系统大多没有人重写，一直跑在老机器上。FoxDevCommunity 这个独立项目把 VFP 的语言本身重做了一遍：运行时和编译器用 Rust 从零写，编译成 WebAssembly，界面用 React，整个语言基础扩到 64 位。项目主页的说法是，不重写、不转换、不导出，直接打开现有的项目、表单和表。

具体数字：表文件偏移量按 64 位记，单表可以长到几百 GB，而 2GB 是 VFP 自己的天花板，主页也提醒，超过 2GB 的表再拿 VFP 打开就不行了。语言参考里的 1722 个元素，运行时已知 1534 个并与原产品逐一测过，还有 3 个没对上。行为以直接问 Visual FoxPro 本人为准，不靠文档。架构是字节码解释器，运行中的程序是 fiber，遇到 MESSAGEBOX() 这类调用会让出而不是卡住窗口。SET LIBRARY TO 会另起一个 32 位进程加载旧的 .fll 库。FoxScript 在其上加了 lambda 和一个 HTTP API，演示里用 .prg 写出了一个能跑的 Web 服务器。Windows x64 和 Linux 都有下载，源码在 GitHub。
items.summary_en:
Microsoft killed Visual FoxPro in 2007; the language stopped at version 9 and at 32 bits. Most of the business systems written in it were never rewritten, and they still run on old machines. An independent project, FoxDevCommunity, rebuilt the VFP language itself: the runtime and compiler are written from scratch in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, the UI is drawn with React, and the whole language foundation is 64-bit. The project's own line is no rewrite, no conversion, no export step, it just opens your existing projects, forms, and tables.

Concrete numbers: table file offsets are 64-bit, so a single table can grow into the hundreds of gigabytes, where 2GB was VFP's own ceiling; the site warns that a table past 2GB will not open in Visual FoxPro again. Of the 1,722 elements in the VFP 9 language reference, the runtime knows 1,534 and has tested them against the original product, with 3 not yet matched. Behavior is settled by asking Visual FoxPro itself rather than by trusting reference docs. The architecture is a bytecode interpreter whose running programs are fibers, so calls like MESSAGEBOX() yield instead of freezing the window. SET LIBRARY TO launches a separate 32-bit process to load legacy .fll libraries. On top of it, FoxScript adds lambdas and an HTTP API, and the demo is a working web server written in .prg. Windows x64 and Linux downloads are available, with source on GitHub.
items.why: 全世界都在换新模型，很少有人谈那些没人会去重写的旧系统。VFP 停了 19 年，用它的业务还在跑，于是有人把语言本身重造了一遍。它的启示不在迁移方案，而在问题定义：技术债的尽头不一定是换掉，也可能是把底座原样翻新，让老代码不被理解也能继续跑。
items.why_en: Everyone is swapping in new models; almost nobody talks about the old systems no one will ever rewrite. VFP has been dead for 19 years and the businesses running on it are still running, so someone rebuilt the language itself. The lesson is not a migration playbook but a reframing: the end state of technical debt is not always replacement. Sometimes it is refurbishing the foundation so old code keeps running without ever being understood.

items.title: 同一个模型，只换外壳，成本降四成
items.author: Unreal Labs · Hacker News
items.summary:
Unreal Labs 9 月 22 日发布 Unreal Agent。这是一款 agent 外壳,号称在生产负载以及编程、科研基准上,比 Codex 最多省 40% 成本,性能不降;比 Pi 最多省 20%。基准都跑 GPT-6 Astra 的 xhigh 档:Terminal-Bench 4.0 上两者通过率同为 57.9%,Unreal 花 1428 美元、28 轮、37 次工具调用,Codex 花 2350 美元;SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA 上 Unreal 为 65.8%、936 美元,Codex 为 63.3%、1303 美元;DeepSWE 1.1 上 Unreal 为 72.4%、1367 美元,Codex 为 69.0%、1633 美元。作者把这点通过率差距归因于基准本身的波动。

省钱靠的是异步工具调用。每次发起工具调用,外壳立刻往事件日志里写一条“该工具已返回、状态为进行中”,让执行在后台继续;工具真正返回时再补一条记录并调用模型。这样模型不必花 token 管理等待、轮询和心跳,一次模型调用之间也能塞进更多有用的工具活儿。第二个来源是外壳足够薄:提示词简单,工具结果做过 token 优化,不用子 agent 和工作流。SDK 提供 Go 库和一个类似 claude -p、codex exec 的运行器,仓库公开,主页没有标价和许可证条款。
items.summary_en:
Unreal Labs released Unreal Agent on September 22, an agent harness claiming up to 40% lower cost than Codex on production workloads and on coding and science benchmarks with no performance loss, and up to 20% below Pi. The benchmarks all run GPT-6 Astra at xhigh effort: on Terminal-Bench 4.0 both land at a 57.9% pass rate, with Unreal spending $1,428 across 28 turns and 37 tool calls against Codex's $2,350; on SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA Unreal scores 65.8% at $936 against Codex's 63.3% at $1,303; on DeepSWE 1.1 Unreal scores 72.4% at $1,367 against Codex's 69.0% at $1,633. The post attributes the small pass-rate gaps to benchmark variance.

The saving mechanism is asynchronous tool calls. On every tool call the harness immediately appends an event-log record saying the tool has returned with status in-progress, letting execution continue in the background, then appends the real result and calls the model when the tool finishes. That keeps the model from spending tokens managing waits, polls, and heartbeats, and lets more useful tool work fit between model calls. The second source is a deliberately thin harness: simple prompts, token-optimized tool results, and no sub-agents or workflows. The SDK ships a Go library and a runner comparable to claude -p or codex exec; the repo is public, and the page states no pricing or license terms.
items.why: 详见今日行动第三条。同一个模型、同一个推理档位,只换外面那层,钱就能差出四成。这说明眼下能比的已不只是模型,外壳可以单独拉出来当变量测,比换模型便宜得多。
items.why_en: See the third action item. Same model, same effort level, only the outer layer changed, and the cost differs by 40%. What you can benchmark is no longer just the model: the harness is now a variable you can isolate and test, far more cheaply than switching models.
items.flag: 评论区有人指出,主页最上面那张对比图里 Unreal 用的是 Astra 的 xhigh 档,Codex 用的是 max 档,两边推理档位并不一致;正文 benchmark 小节里两边才都是 xhigh。
items.flag_en: Commenters point out that in the headline chart on the page, Unreal runs Astra at xhigh while Codex runs at max, so the effort levels are not matched; only in the benchmark section further down are both at xhigh.

items.title: Waymo 补贴你去坐公交，一次 2.85 美元
items.title_en: Waymo will pay you $2.85 to take the bus
items.author: Waymo · Hacker News
items.summary:
Waymo 9 月 21 日上线 Transit Rewards:一次 Waymo 行程和一次公共交通行程若在两小时内完成,返 2.85 美元 Waymo Cash。官方说明称,这是旧金山一张公交票的价钱。首发范围是旧金山湾区,覆盖当地 27 家接受 Visa 非接触拍卡支付的公交机构,另有 Caltrain 合作,Waymo 租下 40 个车站停车位。条件是必须在 Waymo app 里绑一张 Visa,两种行程都用这张卡付。先给员工用,未来几周对外开放。官方页面没有写每月上限。

评论区把设计上的缝指了出来。有人说自己住东湾,常坐 Waymo 横穿全城到 Embarcadero 再换 BART 回家,纯为看风景,这种返现结构拦不住这类行程。也有人指出,旧金山不少人搭公交用的是 Clipper 交通卡而不是信用卡,这条要求正好把他们排除在外。还有人提到,Waymo 眼下的瓶颈是车不够,不是没人坐。
items.summary_en:
Waymo launched Transit Rewards on September 21: when a Waymo trip and a public transit trip happen within two hours of each other, riders get $2.85 in Waymo Cash, which the post describes as the cost of a bus fare in San Francisco. The initial footprint is the San Francisco Bay Area, covering all 27 local transit agencies that accept contactless Visa tap-to-pay, plus a Caltrain partnership under which Waymo leases 40 dedicated station parking spaces. The catch is that riders must link a Visa card in the Waymo app and use that same card for both the Waymo trip and the transit leg. It started with employees and opens to the public in the coming weeks. The page states no monthly cap.

The comments found the seams. One rider says he lives in the East Bay and often takes gratuitous Waymo trips across the city to Embarcadero just to ride BART home for the scenery, a pattern this reward structure does nothing to stop. Others note that plenty of San Francisco transit riders use the Clipper card rather than a credit card, which this requirement excludes entirely. Another points out Waymo's real bottleneck right now is not enough cars, not too few riders.
items.why: 这是一条定价样本,不是出行新闻。补贴的钱只够一张公交票,条件却卡在“同一张 Visa 两段都用”,等于用一个很精确的支付条件去筛人。值得记的是它的形状:用很小的额度去改一个很大的习惯,而改不动的地方,评论区已经替你找出来了。
items.why_en: This is a pricing sample, not a mobility story. The subsidy is worth exactly one bus fare, but the condition hinges on using the same Visa for both legs, which filters people with a very precise payment requirement. What is worth remembering is the shape: a tiny amount of money aimed at changing a very large habit, with the places it fails already mapped out in the comments.

items.title: 十个 agent，不如给一个 agent 十倍 token
items.title_en: Ten agents lose to one agent given ten times the tokens
items.author: Toby Ord · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Toby Ord 拿 OpenAI 发布 GPT 5.6 Sol 时给出的数据做了一次分析,把两种扩展方式分开:加 agent 的数量叫 swarm scaling,拉长单个 agent 的思考链叫 duration scaling。结论是加 agent 这条路有明显折损。4 个 agent 要达到单个 agent 的效果,总 token 大约要多花一倍;16 个 agent 要多花约四倍。

他给这个折损写了一个参数 λ。测得的值是:BrowseComp 0.68(90% 置信区间 0.63 到 0.76),SEC-Bench Pro 0.57(0.52 到 0.61),Terminal-Bench 0.48(0.40 到 0.57)。agent 数量翻十倍,收益按 10 的 λ 次方增长,也就是三到五倍;想顶上一百倍的 token 扩展,需要 900 到 15000 倍的 agent 数量。他那次一万个 agent、跑了 88 小时、五百万条消息、三千亿 token 的解 Navier-Stokes 实验,按 API 价格估算约 2000 万美元。

swarm 并不是没用,它买的是速度不是效率:4 倍的钱大约换到四分之一的时间。Ord 建议盯住 λ 这个数字,尤其盯住有没有新的编排方法能把它抬上去,因为 λ 高会让智能爆炸更容易发生。他测出的值和他原本期望的低值不符,反倒和此前模型里默认的 0.5、Davidson 与 Houlden 的 0.6 对得上。
items.summary_en:
Toby Ord analyzed the data OpenAI published with GPT 5.6 Sol, separating two ways to scale: adding agents, which he calls swarm scaling, and lengthening a single agent's chain of thought, which he calls duration scaling. The conclusion is that adding agents carries a real penalty. A 4-agent swarm needs roughly twice the total tokens to match a single agent; a 16-agent swarm needs about four times as many.

He writes that penalty as a parameter, lambda. The measured values: BrowseComp at 0.68 (90% CI 0.63 to 0.76), SEC-Bench Pro at 0.57 (0.52 to 0.61), Terminal-Bench at 0.48 (0.40 to 0.57). Scaling agent count by 10x yields only 10^lambda times the gain, meaning three to five times, so matching a 100x token scale-up would require 900x to 15,000x more agents. His 10,000-agent Navier-Stokes run, which took 88 hours, five million messages, and 300 billion tokens, comes to roughly $20 million at API prices.

Swarms are not useless; what they buy is speed, not efficiency: about four times the cost for roughly a quarter of the time. Ord suggests watching lambda closely, especially for new orchestration methods that might raise it, since a high lambda makes intelligence explosions more likely. The values he measured did not match the lower figure he had hoped for; they line up instead with the 0.5 default used in prior models and with Davidson and Houlden's 0.6.
items.why: “多开几个 agent”是眼下最容易被当成免费午餐的做法。这条给了一个可以直接用的换算:并行的收益按 λ 次方打折,而 λ 大致在 0.5 上下。如果你手上那条任务并不赶时间,把同样的钱花在给单个 agent 更多 token 上,通常更划算。
items.why_en: "Just spin up more agents" is the easiest thing this year to mistake for a free lunch. Here is a conversion you can use directly: parallel gains are discounted by a power of lambda, and lambda sits around 0.5. If the task in front of you is not time-critical, the same money usually goes further spent on more tokens for one agent.

items.title: AWS 把外壳也做成了产品，只差模型自己带
items.title_en: AWS ships the harness too, everything but the model
items.author: The Letter Two · TLDR AI
items.summary:
AWS 放出 Strands Harness，定位是「除模型之外全都带」的现成 agent：模型可换，其余默认值都写在普通代码里，可以改。它扩展自 2025 年 5 月发布的 Strands Agents SDK，是该 SDK 的一个预配置实例。

能力清单：搜网页、跑命令、改文件、跨会话保留记忆，给出 session ID 就能接着上次的对话；把开放式子任务交给内置的助手 agent；用自己维护的清单跟踪多步任务；自己管上下文窗口，把体积大的工具结果挪到文件里，并缓存请求里重复的部分。支持 Anthropic 的 Agent Skills 格式，模型可选 Amazon Bedrock、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google，也能接本地 Ollama。

AWS 自己给的数字是：七个基准上换用同一模型，便宜 26%；一次 Fable 5 的评测里比 Claude Code 便宜 77%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 的分数还更高，该版本后来被 4.0 取代。文章也照实写了另一半：在 token 效率上有一个外壳比 Strands 更高，那个外壳来自 DeepSeek。发布渠道是 PyPI 上的 Python 包、npm 上的 TypeScript 包和一个 Strands CLI，一条命令安装。用 AWS 或者 Bedrock 不是前提，运行环境和要接的工具都得自己出。
items.summary_en:
AWS released Strands Harness, pitched as a ready-to-run agent that brings everything except the model. The model is swappable and every other default lives in ordinary code you can edit. It extends the Strands Agents SDK, introduced in May 2025, and is essentially a preconfigured instance of it.

The capability list: search the web, run commands, edit files, and retain memory across runs, resuming an earlier conversation when handed a session ID; delegate open-ended subtasks to a built-in helper agent; track multi-step work against a self-maintained checklist; and manage its own context window by offloading bulky tool results to files and caching the reused parts of requests. It supports Anthropic's Agent Skills format, and the model can be Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or a local Ollama instance.

AWS's own numbers: 26% cheaper using the same model across seven benchmarks, and in one Fable 5 evaluation 77% cheaper than Claude Code while scoring higher on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a version since superseded by 4.0. The article also prints the other half: one harness beat Strands on token efficiency, and it belonged to DeepSeek. Distribution is a Python package on PyPI, a TypeScript package on npm, and a Strands CLI, installed with a single command. AWS or Bedrock is not a prerequisite; you supply the runtime and the tools you connect.
items.why: 这两天两个外壳被端上来，一个卖省成本，一个卖开箱即用。它们共同说明一件正在发生的事：模型之外那一层开始有独立产品、独立的对比数据，也有了独立的价格战。选型时这一层值得单独立项测，别跟着模型一起打包决定。
items.why_en: Two harnesses arrived within two days, one selling lower cost and one selling turnkey setup. Together they show something already happening: the layer outside the model now has standalone products, standalone comparison data, and its own price war. When you pick a stack, that layer deserves to be tested as its own line item rather than bundled into the model decision.

items.title: 开源和闭源还差两到五个月
items.title_en: Open weights trail closed models by two to five months
items.author: Nathan Lambert · Interconnects · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Nathan Lambert 给出几组量化判断：开源权重和闭源前沿的差距按估算在 2 到 5 个月。中国的开源模型大约落后美国闭源前沿 2 到 5 个月，美国的开源模型则落后 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 大约 6 到 9 个月。

他判断开源已经跨过商业可用的拐点。证据主要在使用量：OpenRouter 上开源模型的处理量从 2025 年 9 月某一周的约 1 万亿 token，涨到今天的每周约 80 万亿，中国模型的市场份额同期从约 70% 升到 80% 以上；OpenCode 上来自中国模型的推理量约占 95% 或更高。学术端，中国开源模型出现在 38% 的 AI 论文里，美国是 28%。Hugging Face 下载量中国约 16 亿，总数 32 亿，约是美国的两倍。他估计蒸馏只能解释 1 到 2 个月的差距。结论是中国的几家公司会继续当开源生态的领头者，开源越过新的能力门槛只是时间问题。
items.summary_en:
Nathan Lambert offers several quantified judgments: the distance between open weights and the closed frontier is an estimated two to five months. Chinese open-weight models trail the closed American frontier by roughly two to five months, while American open-weight models sit about six to nine months behind OpenAI and Anthropic.

His read is that open models have crossed the commercial viability threshold. The evidence is mostly usage: OpenRouter volume on open models went from about 1 trillion tokens in one week of September 2025 to roughly 80 trillion tokens per week today, with Chinese models rising from about 70% market share to over 80% in the same period; on OpenCode, inference volume from Chinese models runs around 95% or higher. In academia, Chinese open-weight models appear in 38% of AI papers against 28% for the US. On Hugging Face, China accounts for roughly 1.6B of 3.2B total downloads, about twice America's. He estimates distillation explains only one to two months of the gap. His conclusion: Chinese labs will keep leading the open-weight ecosystem, and it is a matter of when, not if, open models cross the thresholds that unlock new workflows.
items.why: 如果你现在为一个闭源模型付钱，理由通常是「开源还差一截」。这条把这个理由量化了：差 2 到 5 个月，而且这几个月的内容主要是使用量和配套，不是能不能用。差一截和不能用是两件事，选型时值得分开评估。
items.why_en: If you pay for a closed model today, the usual reason is that open weights are still behind. This piece puts a number on that: two to five months, and what fills those months is mostly usage and tooling rather than whether it works at all. Behind is not the same as unusable, and the two are worth evaluating separately when you pick a stack.

items.title: 前沿实验室的护城河，大概只有一到两个模型那么厚
items.title_en: Frontier labs' moat is one, maybe two models deep
items.author: Rohit Krishnan · Strange Loop Canon · TLDR AI
items.author_en: Rohit Krishnan · Strange Loop Canon · TLDR AI
items.summary:
Rohit Krishnan 拆了一遍前沿实验室的账：一次训练跑下来，训练 10 亿美元，数据再 10 亿，人才再 10 亿。收入端要顶替的是每年增长三倍、规模约 1000 亿美元的收入；消费者在 AI token 上的支出超过 2000 亿美元，而这笔钱现在被 CFO 当成一笔新的运营开支逐项审视。

他的判断是护城河只有一到两个模型那么厚。DeepSeek、GLM、Minimax 这些名字已经追上来了，便宜的模型便宜得不像话。所以实验室在往别处铺：OpenAI 用消费端的体量做广告平台，潜在用户规模 10 亿以上，同时重回机器人；Anthropic 自己开湿实验室，想做癌症。作为参照，他提到 Meta 当年在元宇宙上花了近 900 亿美元。他预期实验室只能维持领先一到两个模型，代价却是十倍的开销，这种局面维持不了太久。他信「能把具体事情做好的超级智能」，不信「什么都能做的那个」；对白领就业，他的观察是支出涨了一千倍，就业也没见明显变化。
items.summary_en:
Rohit Krishnan works through the frontier-lab math: a training run costs $1B, another $1B for data, another $1B for talent. On the revenue side, labs have to supplant $100B of revenue growing 3x a year; consumers spend $200B+ on AI tokens, and that line is now being scrutinized by CFOs as a new operating expense.

His judgment is that the moat is only one or two models deep. DeepSeek, GLM, and Minimax have already caught up, and the cheap models are dirt cheap. So the labs are spreading sideways: OpenAI is using its consumer scale to build an ad platform with a potential audience above 1B users while getting back into robotics, and Anthropic runs its own wet labs to try to cure cancer. For scale he notes that Meta spent nearly $90 billion on the metaverse. He expects labs to stay only one or two models ahead while spending ten times more, a situation that cannot run indefinitely. He believes in superintelligences that do specific things well, and is skeptical of one that can do everything; on white-collar employment, his observation is that spending rose a thousandfold with no visible impact.
items.why: 广告、机器人、湿实验室看着是三件事，其实是同一个财务动作：模型本身的领先只剩一到两代，实验室得去找一个不靠「我模型更强」的收入口子。判断 AI 产品的长期成本，这一条比任何一次降价都更值得记。
items.why_en: Advertising, robotics, and wet labs look like three different moves, but they are one financial action: once the model lead is only a generation or two deep, a lab has to find a revenue line that does not depend on "my model is stronger." For judging the long-run cost of AI products, this is worth more than any single price cut.
